text_block_list.name: Bouquet & Loves
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She has brilliantly claimed victory in 
this fierce battle! Loves Only You...!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —I... couldn't win...! ...Ngh... Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Gh, I'm so sorry...!

"I shake my head. It was a race where she 
poured out everything she had right now."
choice_data_list:
――That was a great race! Let's carry this 
into the next one!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Ghk, yes—!

And so, though the Yushun Himba (Oaks) 
ended with the lingering frustration of 
having fallen just short—

Afterward, the aftershocks of Loves Only 
You's victory showed no signs of stopping 
for quite a while.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
When you think of the most dazzling 
Umamusume of our time, who comes to mind?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think it's gotta be Loves? I 
mean, she was incredible in the Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I watched the TV special, so I was 
cheering for Loves Only You. You've been 
running her fan community for a long time 
now, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Social media was overflowing with fan art 
of her, too. It really shows how much 
she's loved.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm considering joining her fan 
community.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Ah, me too! It looked like so much fun, 
so—

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text: "Loveeees!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Everyone—

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"That was an amazing race!" "We love you!" 
"The oak crown belongs to you!" "Great 
job!" "Let's go win together next time 
too, Loves-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, fufu! Yeah..., yeah!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Thank you!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Every single person is cheering for her 
from the bottom of their heart, and that 
feeling spreads to everyone around them—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(So this is love... The bond between 
Loves-san and the commu-members...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(That is precisely why it shines so 
brilliantly.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...— It's a complete defeat... isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (...No, but—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Next time, without fail, I will gather 
all the light upon you.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I can definitely do it. The way I am 
right now.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Would you allow me to proceed to the Shuka 
Sho next?

The Shuka Sho—the final leg of the Tiara 
route. A 2,000-meter medium-distance race 
held at Kyoto.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I want to offer you a golden bouquet. 
Under these unchanging feelings—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I want to gather autumn blossoms into a 
bouquet. Together with a brilliance that 
yields to nothing.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"—I will definitely... become much, much 
stronger than I am now...!"

Beneath that gentle voice, one could feel 
an unshakeable resolve.

Though she missed out on victory, her run 
in the Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks) was by 
no means poor. Winning the Shuka Sho 
shouldn't just be a dream—

—As I watched her leave the Trainer's 
office, I steeled my resolve.

May she deliver results next time. And may 
she receive the recognition from the world 
that her true ability deserves.
choice_data_list:
(She definitely has the ability. The rest 
is up to me.)

(She definitely has the ability. The rest 
is up to me.)

text_block_list.text:
There is much we can do. I want to devote 
as much time as possible to lead us to 
victory.

"At the Shuka Sho where the top of our 
generation gather, next time for sure. I 
want to support her so she can become the 
most radiant star of all."
